AboutMe.introduction: Hi there! I'm Derek, a trainee web developer with a lot of enthusiasm to learn.

first.description: Development and implementation of internal web applications to optimize and digitize plant floor workflows. Creation of interactive and reactive interfaces using Vue.js, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS / PrimeVue. Backend development of business logic and service integration using Laravel.

second.description: Provided technical assistance and customer support entirely in English within an international professional environment. Edited and produced corporate graphic materials using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.

third.description: Managed, updated, and continuously maintained two corporate websites using the WordPress content management system. Designed advertising materials, posters, and promotional brochures.
